summary.text: Vicki Davis is the Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 121 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Joe Angelino.

paragraphs.text: Davis was the Democratic candidate for the same seat in 2024, when Angelino defeated her 67.5 percent to 32.4 percent.
Ballotpedia reports that she had not completed its 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
